leverage.exposure: Balance is positive and no leveraged position is open going into the lock, so there is no matchday-zero risk. Winning the Schwolow auction would open a deficit, but only after MD6 has already begun, with more than a week to unwind before the next lock. That is the safest shape leverage can take and it carries no penalty risk for this matchday.

binding_gap: Goalkeeper, and it is unfixable for this matchday. Neuer is benched and no replacement keeper can be acquired before the lock. The gap is real but it is an MD7 problem, not an MD6 one, because the only fix on the board resolves after the lock.

verdict.headline: Last run before the MD6 lock, and there is nothing left to do before it.
verdict.headline_short: Last run before the MD6 lock, and there is nothing left to do before i
verdict.detail: Last run before the MD6 lock, and there is nothing left to do before it. Every listing on the board — board and manager alike, keepers included — expires after the lock, so the eleven that are placed are the eleven that score. The only open action, the Schwolow bid, resolves well after MD6 and remains unplaced. Place it or don't; it cannot help or hurt this matchday either way.

sell.reason: No sale is recommended before the lock, and selling Neuer now would leave no goalkeeper, no legal formation and the minus-hundred penalty. His sale remains pencilled in only as the funding leg of the Schwolow buy, and that leg is now weaker than when it was written: Neuer's season average is the higher of the two keepers, and a keeper dated to return mid-week is plausibly fit for MD7. Once the Schwolow auction resolves, re-derive the funding leg against a dated Bayern lineup rather than executing the Neuer sale on autopilot — and if he is restored to the XI, fund from a non-keeper instead.

buy.reason: Schwolow remains the single open buy and is still uncontested — no offers since he hit the board this morning. He is re-verified as a starter on a dated source from yesterday naming him in the Mainz lineup with Zentner among the absentees, which also settles the club-label confusion in his favour. Bid exactly at market value and do not raise: it is a board listing, and the measured rule is that chasing a contested board auction into the high cluster destroys the edge. The timing is the whole point — his auction resolves after MD6 has already started and more than a week before the MD7 lock, so winning him opens no matchday risk and leaves ample room to unwind. Losing him costs nothing.

EXPIRY 17.10 ~21:44Z, i.e. ~27h AFTER the 16.10 18:30Z lock — same structural fact as Caci (Wx5f1xk) and Matsima (W5w8xng): he CANNOT score MD6, so he carries ZERO MD6 risk and no MD6 cash test applies. FUNDING IS CLEAN AND IS THE WHOLE POINT: Neuer to Kickbase at mv 11.298.834 gives 154.435 + 11.298.834 − 6.824.261 = +4.629.008 POSITIVE, squad stays 11, GK stays 1, 4-4-2 stays legal. DOMINATES BAUMANN on both legs — cheaper by 6.824.140 AND ap 106 vs 91 — so Ae9egem stands and needs no re-derivation. SEQUENCING: hold Neuer THROUGH the 18:30Z lock (selling him now = 0 GK, no legal formation, −100); sell him only once this auction resolves. movers.reason: Flip window closed — the matchday locks too soon for any flip to be opened and unwound safely, and the next market-value tick lands after the lock in any case. The edge itself is undiminished: this run's re-measurement of the rising-flag drift came in slightly above the baseline figure carried in the playbook, with the share of risers essentially unchanged, so there is no sign yet of rivals crowding it out. Two questions remain open and unresolved: whether Kickbase caps squad size, which would cap how many flips can run at once; and the fact that this edge is measured in one league over one period and will decay if the other active traders pile in.

fitness.sweep: Neuer is out for MD6 and it is now confirmed rather than inferred: a source dated today has him missing Friday's final session after training individually on Thursday, with Kompany quoted saying he had not trained the day before, and Urbig named as the starter against Leipzig. The keeper slot scores roughly nothing this matchday and cannot be fixed — no goalkeeper on the board expires before the lock. The new and more useful part is the return date: Bayern's stated aim is to have Neuer fit for Arsenal next Wednesday, which plausibly makes him available again for MD7. No other squad player carries a fitness flag.
